label: NECESSARY_2 in KTB for the root, from the T and B schemas by correspondence
meaning: KTB branch of the 'necessary' sense fork with its frame condition derived: the K node, the OPEN T and B schemas and the OPEN reading premise (box-existence in KTB, and only that) give the fork node. Reflexivity from the T correspondence, symmetry from the B correspondence of the ConvergenceCertificate. Without the B schema the branch fails on the two-world order false <= true (controls).

strong_version_needed.STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K: The frame-class readings are box-existence of the same individual n. The de dicto node does not name n, and the tertia via node gives the box only with excluded middle, so neither weak version yields the frame-class node.
